title: Salary day reminder
summary: A few days before salaries are due each month, remind the owner by SMS and the accountant by email.
description: On the day of the month you choose, texts the owner and emails the accountant that salaries are due soon, so the account can be funded and the payroll checked in time. Phone number and email address are the tenant variables owner_phone and accountant_email.

variables.name: owner_phone
variables.why: The owner's phone number in international format without +.

params.name: day_of_month
params.title: Reminder day
params.description: The day of the month the reminder goes out (1 to 28).

params.name: payday
params.title: Payday
params.description: When salaries are paid, as you would say it.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the reminder goes out, Lagos time.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: gmail_connection
params.title: Gmail connection
params.description: The mailbox the email is sent from.

steps.name: Remind the owner and the accountant

input.sms: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': salaries are due on ' + steps.settings.output.payday + '. Please fund the salary account and confirm the payroll.'

input.subject: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': payroll due ' + steps.settings.output.payday
input.text:
='Hello,

Salaries at ' + steps.settings.output.business_name + ' are due on ' + steps.settings.output.payday + '. Please prepare the payroll and confirm the totals with the owner.

Thank you.'
